steps.stdout:
Usage: cto init [options]

Set up optimized documentation structure in your project

Options:
  --framework <name>  skip prompts, use known framework patterns (express,
                      nextjs, django, rails, vue, nuxtjs, angular, nestjs,
                      laravel, fastapi, go, spring-boot, svelte)
  --yes               non-interactive with defaults
  --force             overwrite existing CLAUDE.md if present
  --hooks             install all Claude Code hooks non-interactively
  -h, --help          display help for command
